caption:
Lulu spends the day under cars looking up and gripping tools. By knock-off, the neck and forearms feel stiff.

Remedial massage can help ease that tight, knotted feeling. But if the same posture carries on all day, the stiffness often comes back, so massage works well alongside movement. Change position every 30 to 60 minutes, do chin tucks after overhead work (5 seconds × 5), stretch the forearms for 20 seconds × 2 each side, and grip tools only as tight as needed.

Hand numbness or weakness, or pain that keeps building, is worth an assessment. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
